title: KTP Sponsorship Bond
description: The instrument behind the costly-vouching rule (KTP-IDENTITY Section 6). A bond closes without releasing: the taper holds at the Ancestral Liability floor and the residual persists for as long as the lineage does. Promoted from KTP-IDENTITY Appendix B.2; this file is canonical and the appendix references it.

stake_percentage.description: Percent-points of the sponsor's E_base (1-50), divided by 100 at use

residual_amount.description: Ancestral Liability, 0.1^depth * stake_amount; permanent, see Section 6.4

duration.description: Capital binding period; binds staked capital only and MUST NOT be read as terminating the Ancestral Liability

status.description: Bond state per Section 6.4: residual after closure; released only on a sustained for-cause claim
